radiation_sum.description: Annual sum of ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN in MJ/m^2 (daily MJ/m^2/day summed)

value.title: Value
value.description: null if the year has any missing day for the required parameter

date.title: Date
date.description: Day of the extreme (hottest_day, wettest_day, max_hourly_wind), else null

LocationRef.title: LocationRef
LocationRef.description: Katalogort in der bisherigen Form; ohne kind weiterhin gültig.

PointRef.title: PointRef
PointRef.description: Freier Punkt außerhalb des Katalogs; kind unterscheidet ihn von der Katalogform.

spatial_method.title: Spatial Method
spatial_method.description: null: single POWER grid point at requested_coordinates. area_weighted_grid: area-weighted mean of the POWER grid cells intersecting the state polygon. area_weighted_states: area-weighted mean of the state means. capital_point: single POWER grid point at the capital of the state/region (extremes only; see capital_name).

cell_count.title: Cell Count
cell_count.description: Number of POWER grid cells (area_weighted_grid only)

capital_name.title: Capital Name
capital_name.description: Capital used instead of the area (spatial_method capital_point only)

adm1_id.title: Adm1 Id
adm1_id.description: ISO 3166-2 code, e.g. AT-2 or US-TX (matches Natural Earth iso_3166_2)

municipalities.title: Municipalities
municipalities.description: ADM3 units; always empty for USA (geoBoundaries has no ADM3 there)

type.title: Type
type.description: municipality (ADM3), district (ADM2: Bezirk or US county) or state (ADM1)

id.title: Id
id.description: geoBoundaries shapeID for municipality/district; ISO 3166-2 code for state

adm1_id.title: Adm1 Id
adm1_id.description: ISO 3166-2 code of the containing state, e.g. AT-2

continent.title: Continent
continent.description: Natural Earth CONTINENT of the country

results.title: Results
results.description: Prefix matches before substring matches, then by name; at most `limit`

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: One entry per geoBoundaries level used: ADM1-ADM3 for AUT, ADM1-ADM2 for USA

retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At
retrieved_at.description: UTC time of the geoBoundaries download

simplification.title: Simplification
simplification.description: How geometries were simplified for display
